readback.note: a circuit round's detail line is searched for the English 'Effort 8/10'; if the translator has already translated that line the replace finds nothing and a lower day's 'Effort 8 → 7 today' is not shown on circuit rounds in Farsi
paintDoneLines compares the shown (translated) line with the English; in Farsi they always differ so the line is rewritten each paint, harmless but a repaint every time
paintRateFold: same comparison, repaints every time in Farsi, harmless
renderTimer compares the week-limits row's HTML with the English it would draw; in Farsi the row is removed and redrawn on every renderTimer, harmless but flickers
